findings.text: The source ranks frost resistance MKG-4 > MKG-5 > MKG-1 > MKG-2 = MKG-3

gaps: Table 2 mass units are unresolved; the numbers are source quantities, not grams or a scalable batch.
Sand mass and the binder/water accounting are unresolved; the reported water/binder 0.62 and sand/binder 3 are not attached to either mix because the listed water differs widely (197 vs 31).
Even MKG-4/5 crack in freeze-thaw; higher compression (MKG-2) is not better frost durability.
No strength, mass-loss or porosity values are in the notes, so no results are entered; MKG-1, MKG-3 and MKG-5 compositions are not given.
Both mixes use the single stated cure (20±1°C, 90% RH to 28 days); the notes do not say whether it differs by mix.
